is_anopheles.evidence: The study evaluates field-collected Anopheles gambiae s.l. (specifically An. gambiae s.s. and An. arabiensis) and An. funestus in Tanzania (Page 1, Abstract; Page 2, Study area).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study does not perform molecular genotyping of any insecticide resistance target markers; it only conducts species identification PCR (Bass et al. TaqMan assay to distinguish An. gambiae s.s. from An. arabiensis; Page 3, 'Mosquito collection').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No resistance marker genotype or allele data are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were field-collected from four villages in Muleba District, north-western Tanzania between October 2016 and February 2017 (Page 2, 'Study area').

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article evaluating the personal protection and bioefficacy of LLINs under household conditions in Tanzania.

sub_country_location.evidence: Four villages (Kyamyorwa, Ntungamo, Kakoma, and Kabirizi) in Muleba district, North-West Tanzania (Page 2, 'Study area').

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquito collections were conducted between October 2016 and February 2017 (Page 2, 'Study area').

duplicate_risk.evidence: Embedded within a known cluster randomised trial in Muleba district (Protopopoff et al. 2018), but this paper presents specific household collection and cylinder bioassay data.

supplement.evidence: No resistance marker genotyping was performed in the study; no supplementary files are referenced for genotype data.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated personal protection and bioefficacy of 20-month-old Olyset and Olyset Plus (PBO-pyrethroid) LLINs against wild Anopheles gambiae s.l. and An. funestus in Muleba district, Tanzania. Although cylinder bioassays and species identification PCR were conducted, no insecticide resistance markers were genotyped.
exclusion_reasons: No target insecticide resistance markers were genotyped (PCR was used solely for sibling species identification within the An. gambiae complex).
